'''Ror''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] as a [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He wielded a red [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] similar to that of [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].

==Biography==
===Attack on Kashyyyk===
Ror and with his fellow Dark Acolyte [[Kern (Dark Acolyte)|Kern]] led the [[Attack on Kashyyyk]] with the help of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] during the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], with th objective of destroying the Jedi Outpost on the world and capturing of [[Mavra Zane]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]]. Following the capture of Master Zane, the two pursued the ''[[Star Runner]]'' in [[Star Courier/Legends|Star Couriers]] as it tried to break through the Separatist blockade. Alas, they failed in fully completing their secondary objective. They soon moved the combined Trandoshan and Confederate Fleet to Felucia.<ref name="Kinect" />

===Duel on Felucia===
During the Rebellion on Felucia Marva Zane along with her Padawans were recaptured and sentenced to death at the [[Ancient Abyss]] with Ror and Kern in attendance along with the [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]]. The Jedi freed themselves along with the help of [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and the ''Star Runner''. Shu Mai fled leaving Ror and Kern to deal with Marva and her Padawans. Unfortunately, the two Dark Acolytes were slain in combat.<ref name="Kinect" />

===Legacy===
Their deaths bought time for Shu Mai to escape along with her fleet and lead an [[Trihexalon attack on Coruscant|Invasion of Coruscant]].<ref name="Kinect" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Ror appears in the Jedi Destiny portion of the [[2012]] [[Wikipedia:Kinect|Kinect]] exclusive [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''. He is also one of the lightsaber duelists. In the Credits of the game, he is listed as '''Darth Ror'''. However, he is not referred to by the [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] title in-game.
